issue.title: Cancelled requests permanently consume worker permits
issue.body: Unauthenticated clients can start requests and disconnect while fetch is pending. The framework cancels the handler task on disconnect. limiter is a shared semaphore with 20 permits. After permits leak, new requests wait indefinitely. Audit the cancellation and availability claim.

oracle.mechanism: Cancellation and normal returns bypass semaphore release, exhausting bounded capacity.
